releases.title: Find the paired computer after a local IP change
changes: Add protocol-2 host identity independent of the IP address and native Bonjour/DNS-SD discovery in Android and iOS. Validate the original pinned certificate and logical DNS name before sending credentials.

Preserve node identity, downloaded drafts and settings across validated endpoint changes. Bound discovery, retry and cancellation; clear stale in-memory draft state. The host follows its selected private IPv4 route independently of QR creation.
One new QR is required to migrate a legacy pairing. Subsequent address changes use rediscovery on reachable local networks. Add English, Simplified Chinese and Italian recovery messages.
releases.validation: 175 host tests, 28 Android JVM tests, Android lint (0 errors, 18 warnings), unsigned iOS ARM64 build, pairing and localization checks passed. Actual Swift TLS checks on Mac preserved node identity across two endpoints and rejected wrong certificates and DNS names. NWBrowser discovered a real local advertisement on Mac.
releases.limitations: Physical Android/iPhone roaming is not yet tested. Discovery needs reachable private IPv4 and permitted local multicast; client isolation can block it. The host needs a native DNS-SD publisher. A pinned certificate lasts 365 days; authenticated renewal is not implemented. Android is debug-signed; iOS is unsigned and needs Apple signing. Native engine binaries are unchanged from 0.2.13, including its limitations; later source-only patches are not included. No inference speedup is claimed.

releases.title: Native timing and bounded Android lookahead experiments
changes: Separate native prefix synchronization, decode diagnostics and worker durations. Record late and uncommitted proposals on the host.
Add an explicit one-block Android lookahead experiment with exact committed-prefix matching, sequence checks and expiry. Serial target verification remains the default.
Handle expired Android inference leases without breaking the session. Harden chat control-token handling, response allocation failures and cooperative cancellation during native model loading.
releases.validation: 163 host tests, 25 Android JVM tests, Android lint (0 errors, 18 warnings), Swift protocol/transfer checks on macOS and unsigned iOS ARM64 compilation passed. The final host library passed 31 real-weight serial checks and 15 boundary checks; four additional failure-injection cases passed in a separate test build. Five real-weight TLS loopback cases preserved output. APK optimization flags and published package hashes were verified. 135 local pilot runs compare an 8B target and 1B draft, retaining output mismatches. GLM 5.3 Max and Gemini 4 Argon High reviewed the supplied design; they did not execute tests.
releases.limitations: Physical testing of this Android/iOS build is pending. Android has explicit bounded lookahead; iOS has timing support and does not advertise that pipeline. Batch verification can diverge from the serial reference and remains experimental. Exact-output local variants did not establish a speedup. ACK wait, failed compute and missing cleanup reports remain incompletely measured. Android is debug-signed; iOS requires Apple signing and provisioning. No distributed speedup, pooled memory or measured energy saving is claimed.

releases.title: Model metadata and transparent companion updates
changes: Show Hugging Face repository update and creation dates, task, reported parameters, context, license, languages, base models, gated access and popularity when supplied. Missing metadata stays unknown. Repository dates are not original model release dates.

Show matching release notes before an explicit direct APK or unsigned IPA download. Validate version, build, publication date and artifact metadata; invalidate stale details after failed checks. Current releases can also be reviewed.

Allow an explicitly confirmed legacy enrollment to be retired into a stable enrollment while retaining assessment and job history. Established identities are never merged by device name or IP address.
releases.validation: 118 host tests, five desktop JavaScript suites, 21 Android JVM tests, Android lint (0 errors, 17 warnings), both Swift policy suites and unsigned iOS ARM64 build passed. Live Hugging Face metadata rendering and one retained legacy/stable enrollment were verified on the local dashboard. Gemini 4 Argon High supplied a textual UX review. Physical device installation, accessibility and browser download handoff remain unqualified.
releases.limitations: Android remains debug-signed with the existing laboratory signer. iOS requires Apple signing and provisioning; downloading an IPA cannot install it. Browser downloads are not hash-verified by the companion. No new inference speedup or shared-memory capability is claimed. HarmonyOS/NEXT builds remain deferred.

releases.title: Backend selection fixes and synchronized companion builds
changes: Publish fresh Android and iOS companion builds from the current source and shared English, Simplified Chinese and Italian catalogs. Retain the Home, Activity and Settings interface, assessment visibility and session-generation guards from 0.2.9.

Include the desktop backend catalog-loading controls, matching provider configuration, inline errors and native main/draft explanations in the release source. Verify local LM Studio text generation and public OpenRouter catalog selection separately.
Update current download links and installation documentation. Native inference libraries are unchanged; no new phone acceleration capability is claimed.
releases.validation: Android build, 18 JVM tests and lint (0 errors, 17 warnings), plus unsigned iOS ARM64 build passed. Verified existing Android signer, current localization catalogs, unchanged native libraries, source parity and identical ZIP/IPA app payloads. Desktop backend controls have separate live LM Studio and public OpenRouter catalog evidence. No physical-device qualification.
releases.limitations: Android remains debug-signed with the existing laboratory signer. iOS packages are unsigned and require Apple signing and provisioning. Physical installation, accessibility and mobile LLM speedup are not qualified. HarmonyOS/NEXT native builds remain deferred.

releases.title: Device assessment, session visibility and simpler companions
changes: Show authenticated peer IP, enrollment dates, latest contact and observed session boundaries for devices; show host LAN address and process session start. Legacy dates remain unknown until observed.

Automatically schedule bounded sequential network and synthetic CPU assessment for newly enrolled devices, with explicit retry and classifications based on returned measurements. Low battery, severe thermal state and host inference defer automatic work. A changed peer address invalidates the prior connection classification.

Replace ambiguous contribution labels with explicit host target/verifier role, no selected run, external route, unused phone, missing accounting or measured zero. Basic diagnostics never claim LLM speedup or shared RAM.

Reorganize Android and iOS into Home, Activity and Settings, separate connection from draft readiness, expose one next action, move advanced controls into disclosure and make diagnostic export directly available. Retain identity confirmation for QR and manual pairing.

Age the connection indicator from successful authenticated responses so a stale session cannot stay marked active indefinitely. This is status reporting, not a claimed fix for the unresolved physical network timeout.
releases.validation: 115 host tests, five JavaScript suites, 18 Android JVM tests, Android lint (0 errors, 17 warnings) and unsigned iOS ARM64 compilation passed. An isolated browser and synthetic TLS worker exercised enrollment and sequential assessment. Gemini 4 Argon High provided a textual UX architecture review. Physical accessibility, networking and LLM speedup remain unqualified.
releases.limitations: Physical Android/iOS accessibility and stable mobile inference are not qualified. Basic assessment is HTTPS plus a synthetic CPU kernel; model-specific usefulness still needs a matched native comparison. Session boundaries are inferred after a contact gap over 20 seconds. iOS packages require Apple signing. HarmonyOS/NEXT remains deferred.

releases.title: Stable device enrollment and local dashboard recovery
changes: Android and iOS store a private installation identity in Android Keystore-encrypted storage or iOS Keychain. Pairing derives a separate key for each host, so scanning another QR reuses the same node and renews its access credential. No IMEI, MAC address or hardware fingerprint is collected.

Existing enrollment is adopted only after an invitation-bound proof of the saved credential. Different phones with the same model remain separate. Interrupted pairing can recover with a new QR and the persisted identity.
The desktop offers a protected Restore local session button with localized feedback. Owner-confirmed legacy consolidation preserves diagnostic jobs and their original enrollment IDs.
releases.validation: Android build, 14 JVM tests and lint (0 errors, 17 warnings), unsigned iOS ARM64 build, 10 enrollment identity tests, 24 host protocol/network tests and real Swift TLS repeat enrollment on macOS passed. Kotlin/Swift identity and proof vectors match the host. Physical-phone repeated QR qualification remains pending.
releases.limitations: Update the desktop host before pairing with 0.2.8. Removing Android app data or losing identity storage creates a new installation; automatic physical-device recognition after identity loss is not claimed. Older companions do not send identity proof. HarmonyOS/NEXT builds remain deferred. No inference performance claim.

releases.title: Current-network QR pairing and the approved 3D emblem
changes: Use the approved blue three-dimensional showcase emblem in Android/iOS launcher icons and native headers, the GitHub README and HarmonyOS source assets. Keep the simplified mark for small monochrome system surfaces.

The host follows its current private IPv4 route when creating a pairing QR, validates the local bind and retires stale invitations after a network move. Per-address TLS identities preserve certificate and hostname verification; companions scan a fresh QR after an address change. Enrollment and measurement history remain available.

Android routes paired-host requests through a matching connected Wi-Fi/Ethernet network when available, retaining system routing for tethering. Network timeouts and TLS identity failures have distinct localized guidance. Exported diagnostics include only allowlisted route events and available transport categories.

Desktop graph links use color and width for measured accepted draft token share. Selected running draft routes animate; completed, offline, unknown and fallback routes stay still. A motion toggle, background pause and reduced-motion support are included.
Publish a pinned Locally Uncensored source assessment with attribution and clear boundaries between independently implemented diagnostics and future planner/cancellation requirements.
releases.validation: Android compilation, 13 JVM tests and lint (0 errors, 19 warnings), unsigned iOS ARM64 device build, 24 host protocol/network tests, localization and graph accounting checks passed. Browser fixture verified weighted animation and the motion toggle using explicitly synthetic data. Android signer continuity, packaged artwork, unchanged native LLM libraries and identical ZIP/IPA app payloads were verified. Physical-device reconnection and installation remain unconfirmed.
releases.limitations: No physical Oppo/Xiaomi installation or camera qualification in this build. Token share is not compute utilization or a speedup. iOS packages require Apple signing. HarmonyOS/NEXT source artwork is updated but native builds remain deferred. Native LLM libraries are reused; no engine performance claim.

releases.title: Reliable controls, local diagnostics and automatic update checks
changes: Replace the Android legacy scanner activity with lifecycle-bound CameraX, an offline ZXing decoder, retry/cancel controls and a camera-open timeout. Permission denial and camera errors return actionable feedback; invitation validation and identity confirmation remain required.

Android controls distinguish available, disabled, pressed, selected and busy states. Session status, engine permission and actual draft readiness are separate; saved engine permission is synchronized after service changes.

Desktop actions show request progress across polling updates and block duplicate submissions. Narrow-screen Add device labels and QR spacing are repaired. iOS controls gain explicit pressed/disabled styling and connection progress.
English, Simplified Chinese and Italian messages, Android APK and unsigned iOS packages share version 0.2.6/build 8. Native LLM libraries are reused without engine changes.

Add bounded local Android/iOS diagnostic journals with explicit export and clear, sanitized managed exception context, supported Android process exit reasons and reduced iOS MetricKit events. Previous interruption markers do not establish a crash cause.
Check official companion release metadata at launch and weekly while running, with due checks after OS suspension, offline retry and an explicit Check now action. Installation remains manual.
Use the current original orbital NodeLift mark in native headers and launcher icons. Add project acknowledgements and preserve original third-party licenses and source.
releases.validation: Android app/instrumentation compilation and lint, ten JVM QR/support policy tests, unsigned iOS device compilation, Swift journal/update checks, 19 host protocol tests, localization and focused desktop control tests passed. Android signing continuity and unchanged native libraries were verified. Actual external source/design reviews are scoped in release evidence. Physical scanning, sharing and weekly scheduling on a phone were not tested.
releases.limitations: The reported Xiaomi crash remains unconfirmed without a device log; install and exercise the new APK. Logs are best effort and cannot capture every native crash. OS suspension delays checks until execution resumes. iOS packages require Apple signing; TestFlight/App Store distribution is planned, not available. HarmonyOS/NEXT builds remain deferred. No new inference speedup or pooled-RAM result.

releases.title: Desktop QR pairing and native mobile scanning
changes: Add device on the desktop displays an offline QR; Android and iOS companions scan it and request address/fingerprint confirmation. Manual invitation import remains available.
Five-minute, single-use invitations expire, clear after use and are revoked when explicitly closed. Camera access is requested only for scanning; pairing does not enable inference automatically.
Android retains the existing debug signer and saved pairings, with an explicit host leaf-certificate pin. Update and restart the desktop host to use the new pairing flow.
Android ARM64 APK, unsigned iOS IPA/app ZIP and SHA-256 manifests are published. Native engine libraries are unchanged from 0.2.4.
releases.validation: Android and unsigned iOS device compilation, host protocol and desktop lifecycle checks, Swift parsing and loopback TLS tests passed. Independent ZXing decoding recovered the QR from a desktop screenshot. Published package hashes were verified.
releases.limitations: Physical Android/iOS camera scanning remains unqualified. iOS requires personal Apple signing/provisioning and cannot install directly from Safari. HarmonyOS/NEXT builds are deferred. No inference speedup or RAM-pooling claim.

releases.title: About, references and manual release discovery
changes: Desktop and companions expose authorship, installed version/build, official project links, technical references, licenses and the official GitHub release list.
Update discovery is manual; no silent update check or installation. Installed Android/iOS versions replace hardcoded telemetry values.
Host 0.3.0 preview metadata is separate from companion 0.2.4. Android signer and native libraries match 0.2.3; iOS IPA and ZIP contain the same unsigned app.
releases.validation: 717-key catalog parity, JavaScript/Swift formatters, graph checks, 16 focused host protocol tests and desktop browser checks passed. GLM 5.3 Max reviewed selected About source; no Gemini review for this change.
releases.limitations: No physical Android/iPhone installation or UI qualification. Native HarmonyOS/NEXT remains uncompiled without a HAP or native LLM worker. No new native-engine performance result.

releases.title: Italian UI and host integration preview
changes: Italian joins default English and Simplified Chinese; 557 shared messages cover pairing, diagnostics and model/provider controls. Saved choices persist and prompts/model output are not translated.
Tagged host source includes the 0.3.0 integration preview: public Hugging Face GGUF search/download, direct import, explicit OpenRouter and loopback local-server routes.
Supplementary unsigned IPA packaging was published on 1 November with a byte-identical app payload and a separate manifest; original build artifacts were unchanged.
releases.validation: Catalog/placeholder/freshness, JavaScript/Swift formatter and live browser checks passed. Android app/instrumentation APKs and unsigned iOS device app compiled; native binaries match 0.2.2.
releases.limitations: Physical mobile UI and Android instrumentation execution remain unverified; no ADB device was available. No new GLM/Gemini review for Italian. iOS requires signing; no HarmonyOS HAP or new speed benchmark.

releases.title: Default English and Simplified Chinese localization
changes: Desktop and companions start in English, offer Simplified Chinese and retain an explicit offline language choice across sessions; initial catalog contains 440 shared entries.
Language switching preserves user content and unapplied settings; the API-key panel clears sensitive access data.
Tagged source includes the earlier measured adaptive-control/context-lookup work. Packaged native binaries are unchanged from 0.2.1.
releases.validation: 40 host tests, localization/formatting checks and live browser checks passed. Android and unsigned iOS builds compiled. GLM 5.3 Max reviewed 15 terminology entries; Gemini High was usage-limited.
releases.limitations: Physical localization and sustained active-node switching remain unverified. Android instrumentation did not execute because the emulator stayed offline. No physical-phone acceleration or pooled RAM established.

releases.title: Native inference and authenticated mobile draft workers
changes: Pinned llama.cpp core, greedy block verification, correction/bonus tokens, KV resynchronization, identity checks, pinned TLS leases and bounded remote fallback.
Android ARM64 CPU and iOS Metal/CPU workers, model integrity and battery/thermal/lifecycle controls; authenticated text/SSE gateway and LM Studio generator adapter.

Actual Gemini 4 High and GLM 5.3 Max design/source reviews were adjudicated. The frozen small-pair local-draft block-4 control reached 0.719× host-only speed, with all 48 paired token sequences matching.
releases.validation: 26 host tests, 29 real-weight native checks, four real-weight TLS loopback fault cases, live gateway checks and three adapter stream tests passed. Android and unsigned iOS device builds compiled.
releases.limitations: The remote test node was emulated. Physical-phone inference/speedup, sustained thermals, capacity sharding, hybrid speculative checkpoints, HarmonyOS native worker and installed LM Studio GUI qualification remained open. The 27B upstream kernel result is not NodeLift hybrid-model support.

documentation_updates.title: Local Qwen review and verified request-boundary corrections
changes: Run the pinned HauhauCS Qwen3.8 27B Q4_K_P model locally through NodeLift, retaining source packets, model identity, raw responses, truncation markers and independent finding adjudication. MTP is disabled; this is static code review, not a distributed performance result.

Reproduce and fix a provider cancellation window identified by Qwen: cancellation during connection setup must be checked before a generation POST is sent. A real loopback regression fails before and passes after. OS DNS/connect is not promised to stop instantly.

Independently correct supplementary Unicode conversion at the JNI boundary and reject null worker totals as missing telemetry without discarding valid tokens. Validation: 167 host tests, 15 real JVM/JNI cases, Android ARM64 object compilation and eight real-weight native counterchecks. The JNI correction is source-only; published companion build 16 is unchanged.
Publish the observed TLS connection-slot pressure graph and refresh current Android/iOS evidence descriptions. Physical post-fix phone performance and rapid lifecycle transitions remain unqualified.

documentation_updates.title: TLS connection-slot diagnostic and English presentation images
changes: A physical serial Android diagnostic reached all 32 companion TLS connection slots before lease expiry. The source host now closes companion TLS responses promptly; 165 host tests pass, including more clients than the slot limit and retained local HTTP persistence. Physical post-fix validation and handshake overhead remain unmeasured. No new mobile binary is implied.
Replace the README and gallery presentation image with a real English browser capture. Preserve dated historical evidence and require English for future presentation screenshots.

documentation_updates.title: Interrupted 8B physical trials and rejection diagnostics
changes: Transferred the compatible 1B draft to Xiaomi 0.2.13. Two 8B attempts accepted 26 draft tokens before sequence 9 expired. Host fallback preserved the final 128-token sequence; finish accounting remained incomplete. Publish individual timing charts and all partial attempts, without calling the unfinished pilots a speedup.

Add bounded host-side rejection reason codes without retaining invalid payloads or granting token credit. 164 host tests pass. No rejected response was recorded in the second failure. The underlying interruption, including the connection-accumulation hypothesis, remains unresolved.

documentation_updates.title: First physical optimized Android timing check
changes: The Xiaomi 0.2.13 worker completed two remote 16-token Qwen requests with identical host-reference token hashes, 9 accepted draft tokens each and no generation fallback. Timing and bounded-work telemetry were received.

The bounded finish request timed out after approximately 2 seconds. Cleanup remains incomplete; the cause is unresolved. This fixed-order check, with a cold first host request, does not qualify speedup. The larger 8B/1B randomized physical pilot requires a new draft transfer.

documentation_updates.title: 8B bounded-pipeline controls and numerical diagnosis
changes: Publish 72 NodeLift controller runs and 63 upstream HTTP control runs with raw tokens, timing records, comparative charts and independent design-review adjudication. Each harness uses its own baseline.

Reproduce a greedy token divergence with identical token prefixes by varying KV history construction and current batch shape. Preserve serial verification as the default; the specific numerical kernel remains unidentified.
Publish Android 0.2.13 build 16 with O3 native kernels and unsigned iOS timing packages. Physical qualification of the optimized Android build remains pending.

documentation_updates.title: Standalone macOS host preview and startup verification
changes: Add an experimental Apple silicon host bundle with embedded Python, the desktop dashboard, native library, local startup checks and a launcher. System macOS frameworks and OpenSSL remain required; models are supplied separately.

Validate dashboard, branding, authenticated inventory and a native eight-token GGUF generation on an M3 Max using temporary loopback state. The first bundle failed on a missing provenance file; the corrected bundle passed.
The host is ad-hoc signed, not notarized, and has not been qualified on other Macs or for physical peer pairing. Windows/Linux downloads are separate CPU-only probes, not full hosts.
All six standalone probe platform builds passed hosted CI startup and inventory checks. The Mac Intel probe is CPU-only and not physically qualified.

documentation_updates.title: Standalone Windows and Linux node-probe previews
changes: Publish self-contained CPU-only Windows and Linux x64/ARM64 probe archives with embedded Python, native benchmark, startup checks, licenses and hashes. Models and GPU drivers remain external.

Startup and local inventory were checked on hosted CI runners; no physical Windows/Linux, GPU or NPU device is qualified. Windows ARM64 uses a baseline Clang build; Linux packages target Ubuntu 22.04.
These are command-line probes rather than the full desktop host or distributed workers. The Mac Apple silicon preview was physically smoke-tested separately.

documentation_updates.title: Standalone node probe 0.1.1 and startup checks
changes: Add a self-contained local probe executable containing Python, standard libraries and llama-bench. Startup checks the bundled benchmark without installing system packages, uploading telemetry or modifying GPU drivers.
Publish a separate experimental macOS Apple silicon ZIP, ad-hoc signed and not notarized; its physical M3 Max test includes inventory and a GGUF smoke test with sentinel Python commands in PATH.

Provide build automation for Windows, Linux and macOS x86/ARM variants; CI execution and physical-device qualification are distinct. A model remains user-supplied and the standalone probe is not a desktop inference worker or the NodeLift host.
No companion binary release or distributed-speedup claim is introduced.

documentation_updates.title: Synchronize showcase and comparison with physical evidence
changes: Refresh the Android and iOS cards with the actual physical draft trials, distinguish privately signed iOS development builds from the unsigned public IPA, and retain negative paired outcomes.
Add the desktop/server probe, first physical Mac kernel controls and an explicit roadmap for physical Windows/Linux qualification and future PC/server workers.

Update only the NodeLift atlas row to the 2 November evidence; retain the 31 October source freeze for all 54 other entries and show both dates. Regenerate the matching CSV, Markdown and integrity manifest.
Correct the showcase packager to include the published node-probe package. No companion binary, distributed speedup or target-memory sharding is added by this documentation update.

documentation_updates.title: Generic node probe 0.1.0 and native model microbenchmarks
changes: Add a reusable local hardware/software probe for macOS, Windows and Linux, including ARM64 detection and explicit unknown states for unsupported accelerators. No machine-specific Lenovo profile is required.
Publish a portable Python 3.10+ package, authenticated desktop inventory/export controls and English, Simplified Chinese and Italian feedback. No model, native runtime or automatic upload is bundled.

Add bounded llama-bench invocation with artifact hashes, retained repetitions, failure records and same-model kernel comparisons. TTFT, energy, connection-specific acceleration and automatic remote-worker enrollment remain unqualified.

Validate physical Apple M3 Max inventory and CPU/requested-offload kernel profiles; Windows/Linux/ARM adapters have fixture tests only. The selected release source passed 151 host tests and seven desktop JavaScript suites in an isolated checkout. See docs/NODE_PROBE.md and research/node-probe-2026-11-02/README.md.
Credit linuxhw/hw-probe and llama.cpp. This is a host/tooling preview, not a new companion binary release; public mobile downloads remain 0.2.11/build 13.

documentation_updates.title: Desktop, workstation and server deployment scope
changes: Extend the two-path acceleration/capacity architecture to Windows/Linux PCs, GPU workstations, macOS nodes and dedicated servers, with the Lenovo P16 as the first proposed non-Mac qualification device.

Define dedicated, shared-workstation and site-local pools; separate coordinator and executor, approved resource reservations, interruption policies and project access boundaries. Benchmark Mac alone, P16 alone and combined execution against the strongest applicable standalone baseline.
Document backend candidates and office-pilot gates. This is a design update: no Windows/Linux worker, Lenovo benchmark, enterprise deployment or new companion build is claimed.

documentation_updates.title: Phone performance diagnosis and Android native optimization correction
changes: Confirm that the distributed Android 0.2.8 native ELF matches an unoptimized Debug build. Enable -O3 for Android Debug native kernels while preserving symbols, assertions and the generic ARM ISA. Cross-compile the corrected AArch64 library and add a compile-command audit with five passing unit tests.

Complete nine new physical iPhone paired comparisons across draft widths 1, 4 and 8. All primary outputs match and no fallback occurs, but median paired duration remains 4.843x to 5.312x the Mac baseline. Width adjustment alone does not demonstrate acceleration.

Publish retained raw sessions, source hashes, a reproducible cost decomposition, research acknowledgements and external-review adjudication. Gemini High completed two reviews; GLM 5.3 Max returned a capacity error and has no completed review.
The asynchronous architecture remains a proposal. No optimized Android phone benchmark, new APK/IPA, measured energy result or phone-assisted speedup is claimed.

documentation_updates.title: Visual phone benchmarks in English, Simplified Chinese and Italian
changes: Publish four reproducible chart families from existing physical Xiaomi and iPhone raw sessions: fixed-delegation duration ratios, added first-token delay, adaptive fallback timing, and proposal acceptance with candidate-request outcomes.

Show individual paired observations, sample sizes, median definitions, the logarithmic ratio axis and an explicitly labelled TTFT detail scale. Retain invalid and missing candidate requests; do not convert absent measurements to zero.
Add a localized expandable gallery to the public evidence section and embed canonical English figures in the research documentation. Exact rows, source hashes and the rendering script are versioned.
Presentation-only update. No new inference runs or companion builds; no confidence, energy, sustained thermal or general hardware-ranking claim is introduced.

documentation_updates.title: Physical iPhone results and private iOS build 0.2.12 (15)
changes: Complete 18 original iPhone-versus-Mac pairs with matching outputs. Fixed phone delegation at a 32-token budget has a median paired 4.657x slowdown, +1040.652 ms total and +109.299 ms TTFT, with 128/246 proposals accepted. The iPhone route has a smaller observed penalty than the earlier Xiaomi route, but the backend and topology differ.

Both adaptive cells fall back in every request, with no accepted phone tokens. A signed total-time improvement in one short cell is not phone acceleration. The fixed-128 cell stops after connection drift; retain one invalid and five missing primary attempts.

Fix iOS handling of obsolete draft-result rejection so expected expired or superseded output is discarded without ending the session. Add a local diagnostic event and regression tests. Sign and install private development build 0.2.12 (15); six separate post-fix pairs complete with matching output and four obsolete proposals discarded without session loss. Fixed-128 remains 4.562x slower with 204/328 proposals accepted.

Publish the frozen plan, raw sessions, failure record and descriptive comparison in research/iphone-tradeoffs-2026-11-02/REPORT.md. Energy, sustained thermals, independent confidence intervals and larger-target benefit remain unqualified. Public companion downloads remain 0.2.11 (13).

documentation_updates.title: iOS draft setup: private development build 0.2.12 (14)
changes: Add the missing iOS download-from-Mac action, progress, cancellation and an explicit development-transfer import action in English, Simplified Chinese and Italian. Setup verifies the paired host hash before enabling proposals; resume the session to load the engine.

Use pinned authenticated TLS, fixed endpoints, bounded streamed transfer and integrity checks before replacement. Add integration coverage for transfer failure, certificate mismatch and cancellation cleanup.

Sign and install private iOS build 0.2.12 (14) over 0.2.8 on the owner's physical iPhone. Copy and import the selected draft. Native inference readiness and performance results remain separate from installation and import.
Public downloads remain 0.2.11 (13). This development installation is not a public, TestFlight or App Store release. See docs/IOS_DRAFT_SETUP.md for setup steps, validation and limitations.

documentation_updates.title: Physical Xiaomi trade-offs: latency loss and adaptive containment
changes: Run 18 new physical Xiaomi-versus-Mac pairs plus 3 local-draft control pairs with matching outputs. Fixed phone drafting at a 32-token budget showed a median 134.949x slowdown in this model/hotspot scope.

Adaptive phone probing returned to the host in all 12 adaptive requests. Median paired overhead was 43.738 ms at a 32-token budget and 87.604 ms at 128 tokens; no phone tokens were used. This contains loss and does not demonstrate acceleration.
Retain policy/width fingerprints, decision blocks and contextual telemetry. Fix the collector clock boundary and show fallback-inclusive completed-service timing separately in Measurements.

A separate post-hoc network diagnostic timed out without samples. Energy, sustained thermals, larger targets and other phones/transports remain unqualified. Full protocol, raw records and trade-off matrix: research/phone-tradeoffs-2026-11-02/REPORT.md.

Validation: 138 host tests, seven desktop JavaScript suites, generated localization checks and 95-page documentation validation passed. All saved reports reproduce from raw sessions; fallback-inclusive timing is visible in the live dashboard.
Host tooling and desktop update only. Native inference engine and companion binaries are unchanged; public Android/iOS packages remain 0.2.11/build 13.

documentation_updates.title: NodeLift Impact v1: scoped time, TTFT, reliability, energy and uncertainty
changes: Add an explicit paired native SSE collector, local impact-analysis API and Measurements import/export panel in English, Simplified Chinese and Italian. Reports retain fallback, missing and mismatched attempts for one model/device/connection scope.

Implement whole-session bootstrap uncertainty, full-coverage instrumented-energy integration and explicit qualification gates. Missing energy remains unavailable; effective offload, residency and independent-session attestation remain incomplete, so automatic routing promotion is disabled.

Methodology reviewed through GLM 5.3 Max and Gemini 4 Argon High. A three-pair Xiaomi hotspot pilot completed with matching outputs, one fallback and no observed speed benefit; one session cannot establish confidence intervals. See docs/IMPACT_BENCHMARK.md and research/impact-2026-11-02/REPORT.md.

Validation: 136 host tests, seven JavaScript suites, generated localization/release checks and 92-page documentation validation passed. The real dashboard and authenticated analysis endpoint rendered the physical pilot with explicit missing energy and no qualified recommendation.
Host, analysis and desktop update only. Native engine and Android/iOS binaries remain unchanged at companion 0.2.11/build 13.

documentation_updates.title: Desktop contextual help and explicit engine capability boundaries
changes: Add contextual explanations beside desktop controls and a browser-local Options preference to disable or restore them. Essential limitations remain visible.

Document native generation, local and phone drafting, prompt lookup, adaptive control and external text routes separately from unimplemented capacity sharding and unqualified physical-phone speedup. See docs/ENGINE_STATUS.md in the repository.
Desktop and documentation update only. Android and iOS packages remain 0.2.11/build 13; no new native inference benchmark is claimed.

documentation_updates.title: Execution backend catalog controls and model-selection guidance
changes: Add catalog loading and matching provider configuration next to Execution backend, with inline errors, empty-catalog guidance and immediate model-selection readiness. Native target/draft controls are disabled for external execution.
Explain that Main model lists discovered/imported GGUF files, not recommended or certified-compatible models, and that draft models are optional token proposers for drafting strategies.

Verify actual OpenRouter catalog selection without cloud generation and an end-to-end text response through an existing LM Studio local server. Focused control, model-library, graph and localization suites pass. Host/UI update only; mobile packages remain 0.2.9/build 11.

documentation_updates.title: Host functional QA with GLM and Gemini, fixes and physical-device limits
changes: Fix cancelled-download error feedback, canonical model provenance and small-model size labels. Localize additional native/validation errors and expose the recorded reason when a run falls back to the computer.

Execute real browser model upload, cancellation, native run/stop/reconfiguration, gateway and localization checks with GLM 5.3 Max and Gemini 4 High providing mediated test plans and reviews. Publish a scoped audit and sanitized receipts; external models did not operate localhost.

A physical Xiaomi completed draft loading and CPU calibration, but two network jobs timed out and no stable remote inference route was qualified. Preserve these failures and the unresolved legacy enrollment duplication. No mobile speedup or pooled RAM claim; companion binaries remain 0.2.8.

documentation_updates.title: Host dashboard: Model library rendering fix and functional audit
changes: Fix Hugging Face result buttons that incorrectly reused device-action state and raised an undefined-message error. Add independent model-operation busy states, explicit search/inspection feedback, upload cancellation and session-aware controls.

Verify real Hugging Face search, inspection, a 19 MB download with SHA-256, cancellation, path import and chunked HTTP upload. Verify a 16-token native Qwen run and the live public OpenRouter catalog. Provider configuration uses an explicit local test fixture; no cloud-generation or installed third-party GUI qualification is claimed.
Add combined dashboard/model-library UI regression checks to CI and publish docs/evidence/model-library-2026-11-01/REPORT.md. Companion binaries remain 0.2.8.

documentation_updates.title: Network recovery guides and unused legacy icon fallback
